note: Parameters whose pooled value rests on a conversion factor from outside the source (a heating value, a density, a process ratio, a pooled efficiency or an assumption), as examples so converted / examples pooled. Those values are shaded purple in the workbook. Which factors: archetype-parameter.csv (external-factors); how each example was converted: example-parameter.csv (conversion, conversion-class, conversion-factors).

Parameters whose pooled value includes a figure the source prints wrongly and the modeller corrected (a slipped decimal or zero, a wrong unit or carrier label), as examples so corrected / examples pooled. Each correction, the figure as printed and the evidence: records/reference/source-correction.csv; the rows carry the correction-id in example-parameter.csv (correction) and a note starting ASSUMED CORRECTION. These values are also counted in external-conversions and shaded purple in the workbook.

Parameters with no sourced value, filled by the fill step and graded: identity (calculated from this archetype's own values), estimated (from other archetypes or a class rule fitted on this database), proxy (a class constant from a named outside catalogue, records/fill/fill-assumption.csv) or guess (a judgement, records/fill/fill-judgement.csv); not-applicable marks a parameter that does not characterise the archetype. Shaded in the workbook; their _n is 0. Rule, inputs and rationale: archetype-parameter.csv (grade, method, rule-id, inputs, rationale); rules in records/fill/.
